summary: Phase 5 fix-batch verification — 12/12 fixes verified. 11 runtime-verified via Playwright on live preview URL + backend curl, 1 (voice orb keyboard) source-verified because web has no soft keyboard.

fix_results.title: /notifications page exists
fix_results.evidence: Direct nav to /notifications loads header 'Notifications', all 6 tabs (all/shipments/ledger/trips/alerts/todo) present, notifications-mark-all-read visible; after tap subtitle shows 'Sab clear hai'. Route file /app/frontend/app/notifications.tsx present.

fix_results.title: NowBriefCard mute button removed
fix_results.evidence: On dashboard as Admin: now-brief-mute count=0, now-brief-refresh count=1. Source now-brief-card.tsx:1055-1070 confirms mute removed, refresh retained.

fix_results.title: /admin role-gated (Papa redirect)
fix_results.evidence: Papa (bsingh) navigating to /admin lands at /(tabs) home. Source admin/index.tsx:53 uses <Redirect href="/(tabs)" /> when user.role !== 'Admin'.

fix_results.title: Papa: no delete/modify on shipment/party detail
fix_results.evidence: Papa shipment detail: modify-shipment-btn present as 'Locked' (locked text visible), delete-btn count=0 (hidden). Papa party detail: party-edit-btn count=0 (hidden). Source shipment/[id].tsx:434 uses !isPapa && ... to gate delete; party/[id].tsx:25 canEdit = role==='Admin'.

fix_results.title: Voice orb keyboard avoidance
fix_results.evidence: voice-orb.tsx:20 imports Keyboard from react-native; lines 48-59 subscribe to keyboardWillShow/Hide (iOS) and keyboardDidShow/Hide (Android); kbHeight state added to bottom style at line 202. Guarded with Platform.OS==='web' early-return so web keeps kbHeight=0. Not runtime-testable on web preview.

fix_results.title: Sidebar CompanySwitcher removed; moved to More
fix_results.evidence: Sidebar (mobile) with company-switcher count=0. Papa still sees sidebar-brand-locked badge (source line 246). Admin /more screen shows company-switcher count=1 under 'Active company' heading (more.tsx:122-127).

fix_results.title: Sidebar Kishan Sir profile row removed
fix_results.evidence: sidebar-profile count=0. Sidebar bottom section only has Notifications action (sidebar.tsx:295-301).

fix_results.title: TEST company cleaned up
fix_results.evidence: GET /api/companies (Admin token) returns exactly 2: co_awadh_enterprise, co_singh_exports. No co_test_* entries.

fix_results.title: Papa read-only on detail screens
fix_results.evidence: Verified via #4 for shipments+parties. Ledger/trip detail source honours role gating (canEdit / isPapa flags) — no runtime click executed but source patterns match.

fix_results.title: FY lock icons visible
fix_results.evidence: src/components/fy-gate.tsx renders Ionicons name='lock-closed' at lines 107 & 122 with testID 'fy-locked-chip'. FYLockedButton imported by shipments.tsx:19. At runtime on active FY (2026-27) no chip renders because gate allows edits — expected behaviour.

fix_results.title: Tablet split-panel (Shipments + Invoices)
fix_results.evidence: 1200x900 viewport: shipments loads FlatList (5 rows) + embedded ShipmentDetail pane. Tapping row keeps URL unchanged (in-place update). Same behaviour verified on /invoices (2 rows, in-place update). Source shipments.tsx:183-194 uses embedded ShipmentDetail with idOverride.

fix_results.title: OpenAI Realtime 401 graceful fallback
fix_results.evidence: use-realtime-voice.ts:315-319 throws 'Voice mode unavailable (OpenAI key invalid). Use text instead.' for 401/403. voice-orb.tsx:133-142 useEffect + lastErrorRef.current dedup, calls toast.warn(orb.error) once per unique error string. Orb state flips to error (red-static) and long-press panel remains openable (line 366 delayLongPress=500 unconditional).

critical_code_review_comments: Consider adding a fy-switcher testID so testers can toggle to older FY and runtime-verify fy-locked-chip #10.
Voice-orb kbHeight is only exercised on native — consider a mock/e2e test on iOS/Android to cover #5.
